name: voidverguenza
description: Secrets several people share -- passwords, API keys, recovery codes -- encrypted, local-first, synced over Reticulum, with actions that can require more than one device to approve.

requires.name: voidcore
requires.note: the model and the dispatcher; every change to a vault is a logged dispatcher command. Reached through Void Maiz's add_subdirectory, which links the prebuilt libvoidcore.dll, and that file ships beside voidverguenza-app. The floor is Void Maiz's.

requires.name: voidmaiz
requires.note: the thin desktop window and the Void Core model adapter; compiled in with add_subdirectory.

requires.name: voidallomone
requires.note: not used directly; compiled into Void Maiz, so a change to it is a rebuild here.

requires.name: voidpalabra
requires.note: the archive (storage) and, through its Reticulum companion voidpalabra_reticulum, ALL of Verguenza's cryptography: identities, sealing, OS-seeded randomness. Built by Void Maiz's add_subdirectory and linked directly by the reticulum and storage adapters. Configure fails if the checkout predates include/voidpalabra/crypto.hpp.
